verdict.rationale: Trivy's official trivy-mcp plugin advertises 'Natural Language Scanning', letting users ask questions about security issues in natural language. The AI itself comes from an external MCP-enabled client such as VS Code, not from inside Trivy. No native AI-generated insights or remediation suggestions in Trivy's own output are documented. Missing for 10: native in-product AI insights and suggestions, documentation of what the AI generates (summaries, prioritization, fixes), and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Natural Language Scanning: Ask questions about security issues in natural language
This plugin starts a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that integrates Trivy's security scanning capabilities with VS Code and other MCP-enabled tools.
